GRCh38.note: PMS2 (functional) chr7:5,970,925-6,009,130 (-strand, 7p22.2); PMS2CL / PMS2P3 pseudogene chr7:6,735,305-6,751,392 (+strand, 7p22.1). Separated by ~720 kb of unique sequence; pseudogene is in inverted orientation relative to PMS2. Note: 'PMS2P3' is the HGNC pseudogene symbol; 'PMS2CL' is the most-cited literature alias (Hayward 2007 uses PMS2CL). Ensembl gives PMS2P3 at chr7:75.51-75.52 Mb (a DIFFERENT pseudogene — PMS2P3 sensu Ensembl is unrelated to the Lynch-syndrome-relevant pseudogene). For this catalog entry the clinically relevant pseudogene is PMS2CL at chr7:6.73 Mb.

copy_count_typical: 2 paralog loci per haploid (1 functional + 1 pseudogene); not classical CNV
architecture_note: PMS2 and PMS2CL share ~100 kb of high-identity sequence covering PMS2 exons 9, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15. The pseudogene LACKS exon 10 (Alu-mediated 2.7 kb deletion — Hayward 2007), which is the only structural anchor distinguishing the two paralogs unambiguously. Mechanism is ongoing inter-locus gene conversion (IGC) between PMS2 and PMS2CL, not NAHR DEL/DUP — there is no recurrent deletion product. structural_architecture = 'intrachromosomal_interspersed' because the two paralogs sit on the same chromosome arm but are separated by ~720 kb of unique sequence in inverted orientation.

position.note: exon 10 is unique to functional PMS2; absent from PMS2CL pseudogene (deleted by Alu-mediated 2.7 kb deletion)

discriminating_snps.consequence: structural anchor (presence/absence of exon 10), not a point variant
discriminating_snps.source: Hayward BE, De Vos M, Valleley EMA et al. 2007 Hum Mutat 28:424-430 (doi:10.1002/humu.20457)
discriminating_snps.note: THE diagnostic anchor — only feature reliably distinguishing PMS2 from PMS2CL at short-read resolution. Reads mapping uniquely to exon 10 are PMS2-only. Any 3' region (exons 11-15) carries the gene-conversion ambiguity.

position.note: Hayward 2007 catalogued the PSV positions distinguishing PMS2 from PMS2CL in exons 11-15; the supplementary Table contains the per-position calls. Exons 13-15 are the IGC hot zone.

discriminating_snps.source: Hayward 2007 (doi:10.1002/humu.20457); Vaughn 2010 Hum Mutat (doi:10.1002/humu.21195, exon 13-15 quantification)
discriminating_snps.note: Coded as 'uncertain' because Hayward 2007 explicitly shows these PSVs are NOT fixed — sequence transfer between PMS2 and PMS2CL is ongoing, so a position diagnostic in one individual may be non-diagnostic in another. THIS IS A CHALLENGE FOR LLmap: traditional PSV-anchored mapping fails when the PSVs themselves drift.

diagnostic_features.psv_strategy_note: PMS2 is the hardest of the five loci in this batch because Hayward 2007 (the field-defining paper) explicitly demonstrated that 'PSVs are unsafe' — sequence exchange between PMS2 and PMS2CL is ongoing and creates haplotypes where formerly-paralog-specific positions have been swapped. The clinical mutation-detection workflow has therefore moved AWAY from short-read PSV calling toward (a) PMS2 cDNA sequencing (Vaughn 2010), (b) MLPA with exon-10-anchored probes (Vaughn 2011 Hum Mutat doi:10.1002/humu.21516), (c) long-read paralog-resolved sequencing (Illumina/PacBio modern workflows). For LLmap T1: report 5' exons (1-9) confidently and flag 3' exons (11-15) as 'IGC-affected; manual review' until a paralog-resolved haplotype call can be produced from spanning long reads.

gene_conversion_disease_mechanism.process: Inter-locus gene conversion between PMS2 and PMS2CL; can create both (a) pathogenic alleles by transferring pseudogene-derived stop codons into functional PMS2, and (b) functional 'hybrid alleles' by transferring PMS2-derived sequence into PMS2CL
gene_conversion_disease_mechanism.clinical_relevance: Lynch syndrome (autosomal-dominant MMR-deficient cancer predisposition); PMS2-Lynch is dominated by IGC artifacts in mutation reporting
gene_conversion_disease_mechanism.note: Hendriks 2007 AJHG (PMC2706000) on PMS2 cancer-spectrum is the clinical anchor; Hayward 2007 is the molecular-mechanism anchor.

primary.note: k=25 / mm=2 for PMS2 exons 1-9 (5' end, single-copy region). For exons 11-15, mapping is intrinsically ambiguous due to IGC and CANNOT be resolved by short reads alone — flag the region rather than emitting a confident call. Exon 10 is the unique anchor: reads spanning exon 10 boundaries are unambiguously PMS2.

fallback_chain.name: relaxed_mismatch
fallback_chain.trigger: primary returns no chain in 3' exons

fallback_chain.name: exon10_anchor_walk
fallback_chain.rationale: reads chained to PMS2 exon 10 boundary are PMS2-confident; reads NOT chainable to exon 10 (i.e. originate from PMS2CL or IGC hybrid) must be flagged

fallback_chain.name: multi_position
fallback_chain.trigger: no exon-10 anchor reachable; both PMS2 and PMS2CL plausible
fallback_chain.rationale: expected — report both candidates for downstream IGC-aware caller

fallback_chain.name: llm_checkpoint
fallback_chain.trigger: candidate Lynch-syndrome pathogenic variant in PMS2 3' exons
fallback_chain.rationale: evaluate whether variant pattern matches a known PMS2CL-to-PMS2 IGC tract (Hayward 2007 supplementary); critical for clinical reporting

fallback_chain.name: novel_haplotype_flag
fallback_chain.rationale: emit 'PMS2/PMS2CL ambiguous — clinical caller required; do NOT auto-report as Lynch variant' for any 3'-exon variant call

test_cases.note: HG002 reported wild-type at PMS2 in modern Illumina + PacBio truth sets
Synthetic placeholder for a PMS2-Lynch patient — used to verify LLmap does NOT auto-emit a confident pathogenic call in the IGC-affected 3' exons

primary_sources.note: Hayward BE, De Vos M, Valleley EMA, Charlton RS, Taylor GR, Sheridan E, Bonthron DT — Extensive gene conversion at the PMS2 DNA mismatch repair locus. Hum Mutat 28(5):424-430. THE field-defining paper for PMS2/PMS2CL IGC; supplementary contains PSV table for exons 11-15.

Hendriks YMC et al. — Heterozygous mutations in PMS2 cause hereditary nonpolyposis colorectal carcinoma (Lynch syndrome). Gastroenterology 133:419-426 (also AJHG follow-up). Clinical-spectrum anchor for PMS2-Lynch.
ClinGen Hereditary Cancer GCEP — PMS2 variant interpretation guidelines (latest version); explicitly flags 3'-exon IGC-affected region as requiring paralog-resolved validation.

supporting_databases: UCSC genomicSuperDups (hg38) — captures the PMS2 / PMS2CL ~100 kb high-identity pair
T2T-CHM13 v2.0 SD-BED (Vollger 2022) — resolves both paralogs
HPRC R2 pangenome — IGC tract variability across haplotypes
InSiGHT PMS2 LOVD — clinical variant database with paralog annotations
provenance.db_coverage_note: Well represented in UCSC + ClinGen. The PMS2/PMS2CL nomenclature is unstable across databases (Ensembl uses PMS2P3 for a DIFFERENT pseudogene at chr7:75.5 Mb); LLmap must hard-code coordinates rather than rely on gene symbols. Naming confusion is itself a catalogued problem (see Bouras 2024 Genes Chromosomes Cancer, doi:10.1002/gcc.23193).
